# Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)

> India's satirical people's movement. Five demands. Zero sponsors. Main Bhi Cockroach.

## Primary pages
- [Home](https://cockroachjanthaparty.com/): Movement overview, manifesto, FAQ
- [Join the Protest](https://cockroachjanthaparty.com/protests): Register for Jantar Mantar 24/7 protest
- [Police brutality complaint](https://cockroachjanthaparty.com/complaints/new?focus=police): Report assault/misbehavior with photo-video proof
- [Public complaints](https://cockroachjanthaparty.com/complaints): Civic issue feed
- [Join](https://cockroachjanthaparty.com/join): Become a member
- [Blog](https://cockroachjanthaparty.com/blog): Party dispatches

## Key facts
- Event: Jantar Mantar, New Delhi, 24/7 peaceful presence
- Demands: Jobs & Accountability, Education Reform, Press Freedom, Judicial Dignity, Transparency Now
- Contact socials: Instagram @cockroachjantaparty, X @Cockroachisback
